title: Three Weeks and One Short Needle
subtitle: 仪表穿着 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：仪表穿着（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：shirt　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 shirt 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the tailor ① wore the shirt that no customer in the shop would have noted, and he said the wearing was the whole of the week. The ② shirt, meaning the garment itself and not the needle, ran three weeks and stayed unnoted in the book; a shirt, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ shirt in that shop had the same short needle beside it, and the ④ shirt at the far mirror, meaning the collar they kept for the children to mend and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A shirt, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the tailor said the noting is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the shirt was the whole of the matter, meaning the tidiness and not the garment. The ⑥ shirt, meaning the tidiness and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; shirt, he said, is either something you wear or the only word that means both a garment and a tidiness. He said the tidiness is the part they remember.

By 1975 the ⑦ shirt had become a line in an order, and the order had become an argument about the short needle. The ⑧ shirt of the whole thing, the tailor wrote in November, was one shop and three weeks of noting; shirt, he said, is either the collar at the far mirror or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ shirt I remember is the garment noted in the order, which closed in 1977 and is still noted as the quietest in the shop. A ⑩ shirt, my mother said in 1979, is the only garment that improves by being noted; every shirt, she said, is a tidiness that has agreed to look like a garment. She said the tidiness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 衬衫（指裁缝铺里每一件旁边的那一件）
B. n. 衬衫（指那件衬衫本身，与细细的针相对）
C. 固定搭配：wear the shirt 穿这一件衬衫
D. n. 衬衫（指留给孩子们补的那一道）
E. n. 衬衫之事（抽象总称，指一处裁缝铺的衬衫之事）
F. n. 衬衫（指订单簿里写到、被记下的那一件）
G. n. 衬衫、齐整（指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 齐整（抽象总称，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: wore the shirt that no customer in the shop would have noted
The shirt, meaning the garment itself and not the needle
the shirt at the far mirror
the shirt was the whole of the matter
the shirt had become a line in an order
The shirt of the whole thing
A shirt, my mother said in 1979

answers.why: wear the shirt 意为“穿这一件衬衫”，1970 年那位裁缝把裁缝铺里没有一位顾客肯记下的一件衬衫做了一遍。
shirt 意为“衬衫”，指那件衬衫本身而不是细细的针，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记下。
shirt 意为“衬衫”，指裁缝铺里每一件旁边的那一件，每一件旁边都有同一枚细细的针。
shirt 意为“衬衫”，指最远那面试衣镜的留给孩子们补的那一道，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
shirt 意为“衬衫、齐整”，指一件事里人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这件齐整就是那件事的全部。
shirt 意为“齐整”，指人人都穿却无人提起的那样东西而不是那件衬衫，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
shirt 意为“衬衫”，指订单簿里写到、被记下的那一件，到 1975 年这一件成了订单簿里的一行。
shirt 意为“衬衫之事”，裁缝十一月写道，整件事的衬衫之事是一处裁缝铺和三个星期的记下。
shirt 意为“衬衫”，我记得的是订单簿里记下过的那一件，1977 年缝好了，至今仍被说成裁缝铺里最安静的一件。
shirt 为抽象总称，母亲 1979 年说，衬衫是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的衬衫。
